args.title: Update Toast.tsx to make error toasts persistent and assertive
args.body:
File: src/components/Toast.tsx

Update ToastProvider and Toast so that error toasts use aria-live="assertive" and do not auto-dismiss after 5 seconds, remaining until dismissed.

label: bug
file: src/components/Toast.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

Toast.tsx currently uses role="status" aria-live="polite" for all toasts and sets a 5-second timer on all toasts including errors. We should update ToastProvider and Toast so that error toasts use aria-live="assertive" and do not auto-dismiss after 5 seconds, remaining until dismissed.
